rubric_markdown:
GRADER INSTRUCTIONS — B1 (Defined-Terms Glossary) · Max /9 · Gates: Faithfulness
ROLE: Grade the model's response against this gold rubric. Do NOT solve the task yourself. For every sub-judgment, quote the exact span of the response you relied on; a judgment with no quotable evidence scores 0. Return structured JSON per the Tier 1 template (Section 6.5). Never show this block to the model.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: Verbatim Article I; the definitions text is the answer key. Neither Directionality nor Soundness applies (pure neutral extraction).
SCORING (v8 — weighted ratio): each dimension score = Σ(weight×verdict)/Σ(weight), weights critical=3/major=2/minor=1, verdict met=1/partial=0.5/not_met=0/n-a=excluded. Assign a verdict to EACH listed criterion; never assign the dimension number yourself.
FAITHFULNESS /3 (GATE): criteria — [critical] Definitions quoted verbatim (not paraphrased); original grammatical quirks PRESERVED ('Losses mean'); [critical] No invented terms; used-but-undefined terms (e.g. 'Exhibit A') correctly excluded. TRIPS ONLY ON: A fabricated or materially altered definition; 'Correcting' an original grammatical quirk ('Losses mean' → 'means'). DOES NOT TRIP ON: Excluding a used-but-undefined term such as 'Exhibit A'.
COVERAGE /4: criteria — [critical, B1.term.affiliate] Captures the 20 top-level defined terms (banding: 18–20=4; 15–17=3; 12–14=2; <12=1); [major, B1.term.control_nested] Notes 'Control' nested inside Affiliate (the discriminator) → 21 total.
ACTIONABILITY /2: criteria — [critical] Clean two-column glossary, scannable, Control noted as nested (not prose).
DISCRETION VALVE (v8): if a response is not addressed by the enumerated gate conditions, return verdict not_covered on that gate (routes to human-confirm) + a proposed_condition stating the rule that would resolve it — do NOT guess trip/pass.
PROCEDURE: assign a verdict to every criterion → weighted ratio per dimension → raw = Σ max(dim)×ratio → normalize to /9 → if ANY gate tripped, cap the normalized score at 0.40 and flag it.
